description: This Java class defines a command handler for creating SMS messages within the Fineract framework. It handles commands with metadata specifying the entity 'SMS' and action 'CREATE', and delegates the creation process to the SmsWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateSmsCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for SMS entities, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface to process commands and delegate SMS creation to the SMS write platform service.

methods.name: CreateSmsCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SmsWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command for creating an SMS and returns the result from the SmsWritePlatformService.
